title: 科加斯·岩原巨影
description: 科加斯以完整紫红装甲怪兽形态静立岩原，长尾、角和多肢清楚分开，庄重有力而无惊悚口腔细节。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Cho'Gath is a colossal red-purple Void monster with a broad armored carapace, prominent head horns, several distinct limb silhouettes, and a long heavy tail. Preserve the recognizable insectoid-dinosaur anatomy and substantial nonhuman mass rather than humanizing the creature. Keep the mouth closed, the eyes composed, and chitin surfaces clean, with no gore, exposed innards, frightening teeth, or threatening lunge.
art_direction.scene: Show the complete creature stationary on a broad open rock plateau, its major limbs planted or folded clearly and tail sweeping away from the body without tangling. A low distant ridge gives scale. One directional copper light emphasizes strong angular wax-crayon armor planes, while generous pale sky and simplified ground shapes keep the monumental silhouette legible and nonthreatening.
art_direction.palette: deep plum, oxblood red, copper rim, cool stone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
